name: two_block_corr_coupled
description: Two coupled 2x2 PSD blocks (genuine SDP, not SDP+LP): max x1_12 + x2_12 s.t. x1_11=1,x1_22=2,x2_11=1,x2_22=2 and the coupling x1_12 - x2_12 = 0. Each block PSD bound t^2 <= 1*2 gives t <= sqrt(2), identical for both, so BOTH blocks sit on their rank-1 boundary at the optimum. opt = 2*sqrt(2). The coupling makes the 5x5 Schur genuinely mix the two blocks (not block-diagonal).
reference_method: Closed form: each block t^2 <= x_11*x_22 = 2 => t <= sqrt(2); coupling forces equal off-diagonals, objective 2t maximized at 2*sqrt(2). Cross-checked in mpmath 1.3.0 and sympy 1.14.0.
